texts.Forms_Builder_ActionFailed: The form was not saved. Try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Forms_Builder_ContextLink: The record the form is filled in from
texts.Forms_Builder_EmptyStep: This step has no questions yet. Select Add Question.
texts.Forms_Builder_FillBlanks: Fill in only the fields that are blank
texts.Forms_Builder_Intro: Build the form a step at a time. Each question can be written to a field of a person, an organization or a related record. Save Draft keeps your changes; people fill in the published version until you select Publish.
texts.Forms_Builder_NestedKept: {0} grouped conditions from the form's definition are kept as they are.
texts.Forms_Builder_NotFound: This form can't be found. It may have been deleted, or you may not have access to it.
texts.Forms_Builder_Overwrite: Replace field values with the answers
texts.Forms_Builder_PublicIntro: A public form can be filled in by anyone with its link, with no login. Answers wait until processing writes them, and only fill in blank fields of a person already on file. Seconds before sending and sends per hour keep out scripts.
texts.Forms_Builder_PublicNoSite: No Salesforce Site is active yet. Health Check in the Settings console says how to set one up.
texts.Forms_Builder_PublicSaveForLater: Let People Save and Finish Later
texts.Forms_Builder_PublishedVersion: Version {0} is published. New submissions use it; earlier ones keep the version they were filled in from.
texts.Forms_Builder_ReadOnly: You can look at this form but not change it. Forms Admin can change it.
texts.Forms_Builder_RecordsIntro: The records the answers are written to. A person or organization is matched to an existing record first, and a new one is added only when nobody matches. A related record, such as an affiliation, links to the others.
texts.Forms_Builder_RuleEmailThenNamePostal: Email, then last name and postal code
texts.Forms_Builder_Saved: Draft saved. People still fill in the published version until you publish.
texts.Forms_Builder_SchemaVersion: This form was saved by a different version of BarnCRM Forms, so it can't be published. Update BarnCRM Forms, then publish again.
texts.Forms_Definition_NotJson: The form's questions can't be read. Ask your BarnCRM admin to open the form in the Form Builder and save it again.
texts.Forms_Delete_FormHasSubmissions: {0} has submissions, so only a Forms administrator can delete it. To stop people filling it in, set its Status to Closed instead; its submissions stay.
texts.Forms_Delete_VersionHasSubmissions: Submissions answer this form version, so only a Forms administrator can delete it. To stop people filling the form in, set the form's Status to Closed instead.
texts.Forms_Health_GuestAccessDetail: A public form is filled in through a Site's guest user, which needs the Forms Public Guest permission set. It gives only the public form page and its Apex class, never access to any record.
texts.Forms_Health_GuestAccessDone: Forms Public Guest was given to the guest user of: {0}.
texts.Forms_Health_GuestAccessTitle: A Site Guest User Can't Open Public Forms
texts.Forms_Health_GuestReadsPeopleDetail: A Site's guest user can read people or organizations, so anyone on the internet may be able to see them. Public forms never need this. In Setup, remove Read on Contact and Account from the guest user's profile and permission sets.
texts.Forms_Health_GuestReadsPeopleTitle: A Site Guest User Can Read People or Organizations
texts.Forms_Health_NoSiteDetail: A form is public but no Salesforce Site is active to show it. In Setup, Sites: register a Sites domain once, create a Site, add the FormsPublic page, choose its default record owner, and activate it. Then give its guest user Forms Public Guest from this check.
texts.Forms_Health_NoSiteTitle: No Active Site for Public Forms
texts.Forms_Health_NotScheduledDetail: Answers sent to a public form wait as Received until they are processed. Scheduling it runs every 15 minutes as you, so keep your user active.
texts.Forms_Health_NotScheduledDone: Public form processing is scheduled every 15 minutes, as you.
texts.Forms_Health_NotScheduledTitle: Public Form Answers Are Not Being Processed
texts.Forms_Health_WaitingDetail: Some public form answers have waited more than an hour. Check that public form processing is scheduled and that the user it runs as is active, then look at the Error Log.
